resources.string: How HMX PDF handles your documents and reports.
HMX PDF opens, edits, and converts your documents on this device. Document contents, filenames, paths, annotations, form values, signatures, and passwords are never collected for diagnostics.
Diagnostic reports and problem reports are off by default. Nothing is sent unless you choose Send and confirm.
Reports are never uploaded automatically or in the background. You review exactly what will be sent before you send it.
If you send a report, it is designed to be deleted automatically after 30 days. Automatic deletion is not yet active in this build.
Choose each option independently. Both are off by default.
Run approved app self-checks and send the results. No documents, filenames, or hardware identifiers are included; reports include a random report-only install ID.
Describe a problem in your own words. Nothing is sent until you review and confirm.
These choices are asked once in this version and cannot be changed in Settings.
Couldn\'t save your choices. Nothing was sent. Try again.
HMX PDF processes documents on your device by default. Diagnostic and problem reports are optional and are only sent when you explicitly confirm.
These choices were set during setup. This version doesn\'t change them from Settings.
Document contents, filenames, paths, URIs, annotations, form values, signatures, passwords, tokens, raw logs, screenshots, device model, location, contacts, and hardware identifiers.

Diagnostic reports contain only approved app self-checks. Problem reports contain your description. Both report types also include app version and build details, Android API level, locale, and a random report-only install ID so retries can be deduplicated.
Reports are designed to be deleted automatically 30 days after receipt. Automatic deletion is not yet active in this deployment; until it is, reports are retained until an administrator deletes them.
Reports saved on this device that haven\'t been accepted by the server.
Opens the policy in your browser.
Sending also depends on the report server\'s feature availability.
This is exactly what will be sent. Nothing is sent until you tap Send.
The previewed data will be sent to the report server. Nothing else is included.
Couldn\'t prepare the report. Nothing was sent.
This report type is turned off in your saved choices. Nothing was sent.
Report submission isn\'t available right now. Nothing was sent.
The server did not accept this report. It was not submitted.
The report is saved on this device. You can retry without creating a duplicate.
Too many reports were sent recently. Try again later. The report is saved on this device.

No connection. The report is saved on this device; you can retry.
Report submission isn\'t authorized in this build. The server didn\'t accept the report.
The server couldn\'t accept the report. It is saved on this device; you can retry.
The server response couldn\'t be verified. The report may have been received; retrying is safe because the report ID is stable.
Report submission isn\'t configured in this build. Nothing was sent.
The report couldn\'t be saved on this device. Nothing was sent.
Describe what happened. Don\'t include document contents, names, paths, or personal information.
Tell us what you were doing and what went wrong.
Remove paths, links, filenames, contact details, or secrets before previewing. Detection isn\'t perfect, so don\'t include private information.
Sensitive-looking text is flagged, not rewritten. You\'ll review the exact text before sending.
No reports are waiting to send.
These reports are saved only on this device. Retry uses the same report ID, so the server won\'t create duplicates.
The saved copy on this device will be deleted. It will not be sent.
Retry is unavailable because this report type is off or the server isn\'t available.
